body:
Pre-session pass delivered in #20: `design/tools/a11y_check.py` with the committed findings record `design/accessibility/automated-pass.md` covering every component preview and all seven artboards plus the brand sheet (48 pages, both themes).

Checked per page: Tab order and that every focusable element receives focus and shows the ochre ring; no div/span acting as a control; accessible names on every button, link and field; `role=status` / `role=alert` / `aria-live` regions (`CoverageBanner`, `StatusNotice`, `LimitPanel` alert vs status, `WaitingState`); table captions and row/column headers (`ComparisonTable`); the prerequisite map's list equivalent; `aria-pressed` on starter tasks; `ContextChip` names including "Unknown"; image and SVG labelling; button target size on phone boards; each artboard at 200 % zoom.

Two defects found and fixed in `bundle.css`: the ochre focus ring applied only to descendants of `.osb`, so every button, chip and plain control showed the browser default; and context chips were 34 px tall on phone boards (now 44 px at ≤480 px). Final run: 0 failures, 0 notes. The system handoff now records this observed result instead of "pending validation".

**Still open on this issue, and why I did not close it:** no screen reader was run and no person took part — the pass reports what the accessibility tree exposes, which is what a screen reader announces, but a VoiceOver/NVDA session over the previews is a person's task. 200 % reflow (WCAG 1.4.10) cannot be judged on fixed-size artboards; it belongs to the implemented fluid page. Suggested remaining acceptance: one screen-reader session over `design/exports/components/*-light.png`'s source previews (open `design/system/components/<Name>/preview.html` with the bundle), findings appended to the same record.
